pullRequest.hostedChecks: Updated head pushed; prior workflow results do not qualify this head.

scope: Ordinary default-normal HATCH polyline, line, arc, ellipse and selected non-rational spline point elevation; ellipse edge direction; mixed-elevation loss handling. This direct upstream change does not include the larger unmerged MPOLYGON consumer candidate or its system-codec integration. Open and Save dialog loss notes are displayed, including with partial-read warnings. Reserved ByLayer/ByBlock descriptions are cleared before output to match the current codec. Spline move/copy translates fit points together with control points. Spline planar rotation transforms controls, fit points, tangents and normal without discarding Z. Spline scale and mirror also transform fit points and tangent/normal vectors; planar mirror preserves Z.
implementation: Rebased the supported HATCH portions of the prior candidate into a three-file master-based change; original user LibreCAD_3 checkout was untouched.
